messages.subject: Quartz — where we are on the documents
messages.plaintextBody:
Alice, Marcus,

Short update. The investors' counsel has marked up the subscription agreement. The open commercial points are narrow: the founder warranty cap (they want £1m; we're countering at £900k), the de minimis/basket thresholds, and a 'materiality scrape' (a fairly standard mechanism). We've conceded the warranty survival period at 24 months, which is reasonable.

Nothing here changes the economics. We'll send you a short issues list before signing so you can see exactly what you're agreeing.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0048
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
